question: Does the fixed canonical regular interaction have a nonzero complete J2=partial_logQ partial_epsilon^2 U at Q1,epsilon0 on the original N25 pair?
model: At each vacant original vertex use T0+epsilon*Kreg/N; occupied vertex unchanged; Kreg=K2+K0 with c(Q)=1 identically. Preserve original occupations, ambient rank, q=r-1 and E=q^2.
primary_quantity: J2=partial_logQ partial_epsilon^2 U(Q,epsilon) at Q1,epsilon0, with U evaluated at its own original pooled mean-q zero and complete thermal-slope quotient

kernel.definition: g16(pi)=16*partial_Q of the relative joint Kreg_x Kreg_y contraction at Q1; exact signed Bell8 lookup, zero for missing valid canonical keys

spatial_result_boundary: The separately delivered L32/L64 fresh-block spatial C is not this original-U J2 and is not substituted for it. Its observed values do not select the present source, geometry, normalization or null.
joint_source: S2(A)=2/N^2 sum_{x<y, both vacant} g_xy(A). Vertices are linear in epsilon; no coincident-vertex epsilon^2 term exists.
translation_reduction: Against any translation-invariant K,q,E, full S2 moments equal those of N^(-1) sum_{y!=0} g_0y with origin0 vacant. Enumerate only the 2^24 origin-vacant configurations; use full 2^25 baseline normalization, not the conditional law.
port_rule: Fixed N,E,S,W order at each mark. Occupied-neighbour ports use original NN component roots. Each vacant-vacant incident edge uses a globally unique physical edge ID; adjacent marks share the same isolated common edge ID. Do not reuse the noncontact sampler's n+i singleton convention.
moment_conversion: For source, q-source and E-source profiles divide the fixed-origin G16 columns by 16*N exactly once, with p^K*(1-p)^(N-K) or equivalent full h-polynomial normalization

baseline.use: Import root_enclosure, matching_slope_enclosure and U25_over_A_enclosure; use only existing full count/q/E marginals. No root search and no old source rescoring.

primary_null: An unchanged Q1 baseline whose first-Q effective log weight is purely linear/additive in epsilon predicts J2=0
prescore_secondary: In the same traversal split the ordered origin pairs into the four NN contact displacements and all other nonzero displacements. Report J2_contact and J2_noncontact=J2-J2_contact with identical 16N units and full U functional; no new radius or feature is selected.
secondary_null: A global contact-only transmission model predicts J2_noncontact=0 even if the unprojected spatial mean C is nonzero. A strictly signed exact interval excludes this fixed finite global closure. This split is specified before new moments or score are computed.
decision: A strictly signed exact interval excludes that finite global additive closure. If the saved-root interval contains zero, report unresolved with no coefficient, geometry, Q or precision search. A conditional positive Gram does not supply the unconditional J2 sign.
compute: One compilation, one fixed-origin exact traversal per geometry for the missing total/contact joint moments, one rational-interval score invocation for the fixed vector total/contact/noncontact. Local CPU, two independent geometry processes; no Monte Carlo or cloud action.
dependency: Same complete finite N25 occupation populations as previous local/seam/source calculations, reduced by translation; no independent statistical evidence. Spatial production has different observers and dependency groups.
boundary: Finite canonical response only, not unique continuum field, asymptotic H4 origin, a spatial C score, or covariance of separate one-mark activation derivatives. No alpha fitted.
